wizzo.title: Wizzo
wizzo.description: Creative direction and product identity for Wizzo, Wizzo Labs’ AI mentor: a recognizable visual world, a clear next move, and deliberate user control.

x-games.title: Playfold
x-games.description: Creative direction for Playfold, Wizzo Labs’ interactive storytelling product: social posts become characters, worlds, visual plans, and playable experiences.

geovoice.title: GeoVoice
geovoice.description: Spatial storytelling for infrastructure: a map-based experience that helps people understand a place, explore project layers, and contribute location-specific feedback.

speakeasy.title: SpeakEasy
speakeasy.description: A voice-first mixed reality accessibility experience for people with low muscle tone, shaped through participatory research, visual feedback, and hands-free interaction.

petition-ready.title: PetitionReady
petition-ready.description: Making a complex handoff legible: an intake readiness prototype that gives paralegals a clear hierarchy of blockers, evidence, and next actions for attorney review.

creative-supply-engine.title: Creative Supply Engine
creative-supply-engine.description: Keeping a campaign recognizable across formats and languages: a creative automation prototype combining reusable product assets, AI-assisted imagery, and controlled logo and text placement.

material-explorer.title: Material Explorer
material-explorer.description: An interactive material studio for exploring light, texture, and surface in real time, with side-by-side comparison and shareable presets that support visual iteration.

vulnerability-visualizer.title: Vulnerability Visualizer
vulnerability-visualizer.description: Visual clarity for dense security data: a review dashboard that uses hierarchy, charts, and record detail to make manual and AI assessment patterns inspectable.

sound-escape-vr.title: Sound Escape VR
sound-escape-vr.description: Compose a loop and watch the world respond: a spatial music prototype connecting a sequencer to neon geometry, light, and audio-reactive movement.

portals.title: Portals
portals.description: A cultural portal prototype for Snap Spectacles, using voice and hand interaction to connect place, music, and spatial media without a dense visual menu.

die-ai.title: Die, AI!
die-ai.description: A playable piece of game storytelling preserved for modern browsers: hacked Buddy Bots escape Sector 12 in the original 2018 Flash game, delivered through a contemporary wrapper.
